motion.name: quick-reveal

components.name: Primary Apply Button
components.description: The one solid action that commits the selected profile and launches Codex.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 184px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: Highlight; color: HighlightText; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px Canvas; }

components.name: Secondary Recovery Button
components.description: A restrained bordered action for restoring the official background or other non-primary commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 18%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 6%, Canvas); color: CanvasText; font: 400 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 10%, Canvas); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 14%, Canvas); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A quiet 32-DIP utility action using a Fluent-style line symbol and an accessible name.
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: CanvasText; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 7%, transparent); } .ds-icon-button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 12%, transparent); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Library Row
components.description: A compact selected profile or source row signaled by a narrow accent rail instead of a saturated tile.
components.html: GlobalVideo
components.css: .ds-library-row { position: relative; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 6%, Canvas); color: CanvasText; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-library-rail { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: Highlight; } .ds-library-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-library-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-library-row strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-library-row small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: GrayText; font-size: 12px; } .ds-library-row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inspector Value Chip
components.description: A compact numeric readout paired with a slider or crop-focus control.
components.css: .ds-value-chip { min-width: 56px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 18%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 6%, Canvas); color: Highlight; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-value-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 9%, Canvas); } .ds-value-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Media Card
components.description: A bordered theme-aware container for the selected media identity.
components.css: .ds-media-card { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 16%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 4%, Canvas); color: CanvasText; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-media-card svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: GrayText; } .ds-media-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 26%, transparent); } .ds-media-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mobile Pane Navigation
components.description: Two quiet pane choices whose active state is a subtle accent underline.
components.css: .ds-mobile-nav { height: 48px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: stretch; gap: 2px; background: Canvas; } .ds-mobile-tab { position: relative; min-width: 92px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: CanvasText; font: 400 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 6%, transparent); } .ds-mobile-tab.ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: Highlight; } .ds-mobile-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Optical Proof Stage
components.description: The fixed dark calibration chamber with crop marks, safe frame, axes, and focus reticle.
components.html: Preview
components.css: .ds-stage { width: 560px; max-width: 100%; background: #0B0D10; color: #F5F7F9; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-stage header { height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #35404A; background: #11161B; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-stage header i { width: 3px; height: 20px; border-radius: 2px; background: Highlight; } .ds-stage header strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-mat { position: relative; margin: 16px 20px 20px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #35404A; border-radius: 8px; background: #151B22; } .ds-proof { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #596573, #B28B70); } .ds-safe { position: absolute; inset: 8%; border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.75); } .ds-axis-x, .ds-axis-y { position: absolute; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-axis-x { left: 8px; right: 8px; top: 50%; height: 1px; } .ds-axis-y { top: 8px; bottom: 8px; left: 50%; width: 1px; } .ds-reticle { position: absolute; left: 68%; top: 38%; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 2px solid Highlight; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); } .ds-reticle::before, .ds-reticle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; background: rgba(255,255,255,.95); } .ds-reticle::before { left: 50%; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; width: 1px; } .ds-reticle::after { top: 50%; left: 5px; right: 5px; height: 1px; } .ds-crop { position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; z-index: 1; border-color: Highlight; } .ds-crop.tl { left: 9px; top: 9px; border-left: 1px solid Highlight; border-top: 1px solid Highlight; } .ds-crop.tr { right: 9px; top: 9px; border-right: 1px solid Highlight; border-top: 1px solid Highlight; } .ds-crop.bl { left: 9px; bottom: 9px; border-left: 1px solid Highlight; border-bottom: 1px solid Highlight; } .ds-crop.br { right: 9px; bottom: 9px; border-right: 1px solid Highlight; border-bottom: 1px solid Highlight; } .ds-stage:focus-within { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Backdrop for Codex is a stage-led precision workspace: source, proof, calibration, safety, and commit read as one continuous working flow. Its outer shell belongs to Windows through Mica, theme-aware Fluent neutrals, the user's system accent, crisp seams, and Segoe UI Variable; the center is a fixed dark optical chamber that isolates the wallpaper from the app theme so judgment remains stable.

The world is compact, calm, and workmanlike. Controls are grouped by whitespace instead of stacked settings cards, selection is neutral except for a narrow accent rail, and almost no decorative elevation competes with the proof. The wallpaper preview is the only saturated field; everything around it behaves like measuring equipment.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-aware Windows Mica shell around a fixed dark proof stage.
Dominant live preview with a nested safe frame, axes, crop marks, and focus reticle.
Compact source rows and a progressive Basic/Effects inspector.
Precise seams, low-radius surfaces, Fluent SymbolIcon glyphs, and almost no shadow.
One fixed bottom status-and-commit path with one solid Apply action and an explicit restore route.

rules.name: The Saturation Quarantine Rule
rules.body: The preview is the only large saturated field; the system accent appears as a compact signal, never as a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Two-Climate Rule
rules.body: The outer shell follows Windows theme resources while the optical stage remains dark, except when high contrast replaces it with system colors.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Use the four-step type ramp and weight changes for hierarchy; do not introduce hero-scale typography into the workbench.

rules.name: The Stage Priority Rule
rules.body: Preserve a useful proof area first; collapse or layer navigation and editing panes before shrinking the calibration surface into a dashboard card.

rules.name: The Single Commit Edge Rule
rules.body: Status, recovery, and Apply stay together in the fixed bottom bar at every width.

rules.name: The Optical Flatness Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation through tone or a precise border; do not add ambient card shadows or stacked elevations.

dos: Do keep the outer shell theme-aware and the optical stage fixed dark, with an explicit high-contrast override.
Do preserve the 8-DIP rhythm, 6–8-DIP everyday radii, and 20/16/14/12 type ramp.
Do use Fluent SymbolIcons and visible system focus, with 32-DIP minimum targets and a 44-DIP primary action.
Do keep profile/source choice, live proof, calibration, safety preflight, status, recovery, and Apply in one legible flow.
Do reserve the one solid primary treatment for Apply and keep Restore Official Background beside it as the clear recovery path.
donts: Don't turn the workbench into a horizontal wallpaper carousel paired with a stack of settings cards.
Don't apply the current wallpaper's saturation to shell surfaces, navigation, or inspector chrome.
Don't use decorative elevation, gradients, oversized typography, all-caps kickers, or invented glyphs.
Don't replace the neutral-row-plus-accent-rail selection pattern with large accent-filled tiles.
Don't split apply status, safety resolution, and recovery across multiple competing banners or action bars.
